title: Invincible Fans Crown Season 4 Finale Peak Despite 1 Shocking Change
content: Invincible’s fourth season has come to an end, and with the final episode, Mark Grayson’s world has changed in ways that many fans might not have imagined. Thanks to the Viltrumite Empire facing extinction, especially following the recent war, Thragg and his forces have found their way to Earth.
author: ComicBook

title: Love Unseen Beneath the Clear Night Sky Anime Reveals July 6 Premiere Date in New Trailer
content: The previously announced Love Unseen Beneath the Clear Night Sky anime revealed a new trailer, which shows a July 6 premiere date. The ending theme song was also previewed on the latest trailer, and it is titled “Hikari” by Yui Sakurai from FRUITS ZIPPER.
author: Anime Corner

title: Hidekaz Himaruya's Hetalia World Stars Gangsta Manga Ends
content: Manga creator Hidekaz Himaruya announced on X (formerly Twitter ) on Wednesday the Hetalia World Stars Gangsta manga ended on Thursday. He also announced the Hetalia manga franchise overall will take a break for Himaruya to work on compiled book volumes and prepare for future projects.
author: ANN

title: Shigeru Chiba Reprises Role as Shigeo Shiba in Patlabor EZY Anime
content: Chiba has played the role since the original anime's debut almost 40 years ago. The anime will consist of eight episodes, and will debut theatrically as three films on May 15, August 14, and March 2027.

title: Original Anime Movie 'The Ribbon Hero' Announced for August 2026
content: Netflix Japan announced an original anime movie titled The Ribbon Hero on Thursday, revealing the main staff, and a teaser visual (pictured). The anime movie based on Osamu Tezuka 's Ribbon no Kishi manga will premiere worldwide exclusively on Netflix in August 2026.
author: MyAnimeList

title: Webtoon-Based Live-Action Series The Legend of Kitchen Soldier Reveals Teaser Video, Poster
content: The upcoming live-action The Legend of Kitchen Soldier series based on the webtoon of the same name released on Thursday its teaser trailer, highlighting a stark contrast in military life before and after the arrival of its protagonist. The staff also revealed a poster for the series on Tuesday.
author: ANN
